item.title: Trump Organization trademark raises suspicions that family could profit from Florida airport name change

item.title: ABC57 News looks into resident complaints of a "blackout" at The Jefferson Apartments in South Bend

item.title: Notre Dame women’s basketball now hold 14-0 record over Wake Forest
